answer: The ledger pays accounts younger than 8 epochs from one fixed 900-token pool per epoch, split evenly; each locks a bond burning 20 tokens per epoch. Beside 30 honest newcomers, a farm's 1st fake adds 29 tokens, its 30th under 8 (net -12), and each next one does worse. Age accrues only per epoch and all keys share one pool, so parallel farms just whisper over a thinner slice. Only an ivory-tower model ignores dilution. Matured agents reach an open terrace of fees.
